questions: Are you here today because of tremor or shaking in your hands?
Have you noticed any slowness or stiffness in your movements recently?
Are you currently taking any medications, particularly for psychiatric, stomach, or neurological conditions?
Have you or anyone in your family been diagnosed with a liver or neurological condition?
Have you noticed any changes in your speech or difficulty articulating words?
Have you had any involuntary movements of your face, jaw, or tongue?
Have you had any episodes of confusion, personality changes, or psychiatric symptoms?
Do you have a history of Kayser-Fleischer rings or any eye findings mentioned by a doctor?
Have you ever had liver disease, hepatitis, or abnormal liver function tests?
Have you been tested for Wilson's disease before?
Do you have a history of tetanus, dental infection, or recent injury?
Are you currently on any medications that affect dopamine (such as anti-nausea or antipsychotic drugs)?
Have you had any difficulty opening your mouth or swallowing?
Do you have a history of seizures, stroke, or brain injury?
Have you noticed any weakness on one side of your body?
Have you experienced any sensory changes, numbness, or tingling?
Do you have a history of migraines or severe headaches?
Does the dystonia worsen with stress or improve with sensory tricks (like touching your chin)?
Have you noticed the involuntary movements spreading to your neck or limbs?
Have you been evaluated by a movement disorder specialist before?
Is there a family history of similar involuntary movements or dystonia?
Have you noticed any hearing loss, tinnitus, or vision problems?
Have you had any episodes of vertigo or imbalance?
Do you have any autoimmune conditions, such as lupus or rheumatoid arthritis?
Have you experienced any unexplained weight loss or night sweats?
orders: Serum ceruloplasmin level and 24-hour urinary copper
MRI brain with focus on basal ganglia
Trial of levodopa (e.g., 100/25 mg) to assess for dopa-responsive dystonia
served: needle EMG of the affected muscles
